thread:
Priya: Heads-up — onboarding run for model "sirocco-5b" (5B) completed. I ran both int8_per_channel and int8_per_tensor on the multilingual holdout (en, ja, ko). Seeing a surprising recall drop concentrated in JA/KO queries.
Priya: Quick high-level numbers (holdout-multi, n=12k):
Priya:  - baseline fp16 r@1 (all langs): 0.892
Priya:  - sirocco fp16 r@1 (all langs): 0.888
Priya:  - sirocco int8-per-channel r@1 (all langs): 0.861
Priya:  - per-lang r@1 deltas: EN -0.9%, JA -4.6%, KO -3.9%
Priya:  - silhouette score: fp16 0.42 -> int8-per-channel 0.36
Priya: Full eval artifacts: https://internal-evals/sirocco/1778903456 (metrics-bot uploaded)
Marco: interesting that it's language-localized. can you paste eval command and quant config + tokenizer?
Priya: eval command:
Priya: ```
Priya: python run_multilang_eval.py --model sirocco-5b --quant int8_per_channel --holdout holdout-multi --langs en,ja,ko --seed 202 --normalize l2
Priya: ```
Chiara: did you quantize with the same tokenization bins for ja/ko? sometimes tokenization differences produce different embedding distributions (char vs subword balance)
Priya: tokenizer: shared-multilang-bpe-v2 (same as baseline), export via converter-v4, calibration set = default-random-10k (corpus-mix)
Eve: two quick sanity checks: 1) per-lang norm & variance stats; 2) recall@k curve per lang (k=1..100) — if it's mostly r@1 loss that suggests rank jitter, if higher K affected then real semantic collapse
Priya: pasted per-lang norm means: EN mean 1.02 ±0.03, JA mean 0.94 ±0.05, KO mean 0.95 ±0.05 (fp16 -> int8 shift mainly in JA/KO)
Marco: oh that's a 7-8% shrink in JA/KO means vs EN. Could be calibration/calibrator bias from majority-English calibration set.
Chiara: can you run a per-lang calibration (calibrate per-channel scales using language-specific sample) and compare? also try per-tensor quant to see if the problem persists.
Priya: queued two ablations: (A) per-lang calibration (10k samples/lang), (B) int8_per_tensor global calibrator, (C) post-quant mean-rescale to fp16 per-lang. pushing to same artifacts path.
metrics-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/sirocco/1778903456/ (eval.json, lang_recall_curve.csv, norm_stats.tsv, nn_diffs_ja_sample.csv)
Priya: sample nn diffs (ja):
Priya: "q2001,fp16_nn1=doc_77,int8_nn1=doc_190"
Priya: "q2005,fp16_nn1=doc_12,int8_nn1=doc_12"
Priya: "q2010,fp16_nn1=doc_303,int8_nn1=doc_404"
Eve: looks like rank swaps concentrated where fp16 neighbor similarity margin is small — consistent with numeric perturbation amplified by lower norms in ja/ko.
Marco: plan of attack:
Marco:  - Priya: run per-lang calibration + per-tensor quant ablation and post-quant rescale; produce recall@k per-lang k=1..100 and save failing query snapshots (owner: Priya)
Marco:  - Chiara: investigate converter calibration pipeline bias toward EN (owner: Chiara)
Marco:  - Eve: run a gaussian-perturbation simulation on fp16 ja/ko embeddings to see if similar recall shifts occur (owner: Eve)
Priya: started ablation jobs (job ids 1778903460 per-tensor, 1778903461 per-lang-calib, 1778903462 mean-rescale). ETA ~1.5h.
Chiara: quick thought — for CJK, token length distribution differs. per-channel quant may be sensitive to embedding coordinate usage that correlates with tokenization. would be good to compare coordinate-wise variance per-lang.
Priya: adding coordinate variance dump to artifacts (will include top-10 coords with largest variance change).
metrics-bot: rerun started (job id 1778903460)
Priya: interim update: per-tensor int8 improved JA r@1 from 0.837 -> 0.858, KO from 0.841 -> 0.859; EN unchanged ~0.879
Priya: per-lang calibration run: JA r@1 -> 0.872, KO -> 0.869, overall r@1 -> 0.884 (almost parity)
Priya: post-quant mean-rescale (per-lang) yielded JA 0.874, KO 0.871
Eve: nice — that strongly implicates a calibration distribution mismatch. per-tensor change helping suggests per-channel scaling is brittle when calibration mix mismatches tokenization patterns.
Marco: next steps: add per-lang calibration option to model-converter, and add a quick per-lang sanity check in embed-onboard-smoke that computes norm shifts by lang. If shift >3% flag a warning.
Chiara: agree. also add a tiny augmentation to calibration set: insert 2k CJK-like samples when model is multilingual so calibrator sees tokenization pattern diversity.
Priya: filing ticket ENGML-8589 for converter changes + ENGML-8590 for CI test. attaching failing queries and the small runbook snippet.
Priya: misc note: silhouette per-lang improved from 0.36 -> 0.40 after per-lang calibration — clustering regained sharpness.
Marco: can you also include a small reproducible notebook that demonstrates the rescale ablation so solutions engineers can run locally?
Priya: will drop a runnable notebook in the ticket and a short README.
Eve: one more check — please run a small end-to-end latency/cost check when using per-lang calibration (extra calibration cost is offline, but converter runtime unchanged). we should confirm no perf regressions.
Priya: will include perf microbenchmark results in artifacts. thanks all, will post final links when complete.
metrics-bot: final artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/sirocco/1778903461/ (per-tensor, per-lang-calib, mean-rescale results)
